verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only Microsoft Graph API primitives that apps can use: creating Inbox rules, defining categories, setting message importance, and querying messages into search folders. A developer could assemble these into a split inbox, but they are building blocks, not a documented Outlook feature that splits the inbox into prioritized streams (important, team, newsletters, calendar invites). None of the community items address inbox splitting or priority triage.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
